description: Prompts built from external/untrusted variables — indirect prompt-injection sink
notes: Every interpolation of an untrusted-looking variable within 29 lines after a prompt key is reported (deepsec reports the first per prompt key and reads only the first interpolation of a line). The text before the variable inside ${...} is bounded to 300 characters (quadratic backtracking on long lines). The deepsec label quotes the interpolated text; the port uses one fixed label.
